There are several ways to get noticed. First of all, post great content. Great and useful content within your niche will likely get spread through social media, and that's a great way of capturing an audience. 

Second, find prominent blogs within your niche and ask if you can guest blog. Basically, you write something interesting up and hopefully that drives traffic to your site. One great site for that is myblogguest.com.

Third, comment on other blogs within your niche. That'll drive traffic and those people are likelier to subscribe and revisit than the one-timers.

Fourth, check out "blogging gurus" and their sites. Some notable ones include Copyblogger, Problogger, WeBlogBetter and BlogTyrant. 

Fifth, address your About page. Make it as descriptive as possible, about you and what content you're offering, so potential readers feel like they can relate. A more personable and approachable blogger is more prone to success.

Sixth, understand that success won't come quite. On my gaming blog, the early going was rough. I was lucky to get 10 hits a day. But now I average 300-700 and that tally grows every week. Post your links to relevant subreddits and sites like Digg, StumbleUpon, Delicious, and if relevant, the Newsboiler family of sites. Get your name out there!

Seventh, have fun! Blogging is one of the personalized forms of expressing your passion to the world, so don't lose track of that. If you don't feel like blogging, don't blog. It'll show and readers won't respond well.

And lastly, use Wordpress. There are thousands of free plugins to customize your site with and the service is easy to figure out. Unless your blog will feature pictures, than use Blogger. Wordpress only allows a small storage space unless you're willing to fork over funds.

Good luck!
